Which phonemes carry each phonological feature?

A feature can cover many phonemes while its carrier population is concentrated in a small subset. Inspect that composition before interpreting a feature association as a general articulatory pattern.

PhonemeRowsCarrier coverageSole-member rowsAllocated coveragePhoneme scan

Read the denominators: carrier coverage is the percentage of feature-carrier lemma/POS rows containing a particular phoneme. A word may contain several, so percentages overlap. Allocated coverage distributes one unit per row equally across its distinct member phonemes and sums to 100%; it is not a share of the adjusted coefficient.

The feature-map click details additionally show high/low outcome-band coverage and the constituent’s separate adjusted phoneme estimate for that outcome. Those fits have different selected control sets and cannot be added to reconstruct the feature coefficient.
